Zero runtime dependencies (plain HTTP over Node's built-in fetc"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-telegram"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Telegram runtime adapter for DeepSeek Harness** — talk to your dsh agents from Telegram. Every all"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"owed chat maps to one agent session; messages flow in via `followup()`, committed assistant text str"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"eams back to the chat. Zero runtime dependencies (plain HTTP over Node's built-in `fetch`)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"dsh-telegram turns a DeepSeek Harness agent into a Telegram bot. It is a *protocol driver* in the ds"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"h extension model: it adapts an external wire peer (Telegram) to `ctx.agents`, the same role the off"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"icial ACP/JSON-RPC bridges play — but for human chat instead of automation."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**Who is it for?**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Anyone who wants to query their DeepSeek agents from a phone, without opening the web UI.
- Teams "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"that want a shared, auditable chat surface in front of a harness (Telegram history is kept by Telegr"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"am).
- Developers who want a minimal, readable reference for writing a protocol-driver plugin."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**What it does**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Long-polls the Telegram Bot API (`getUpdates`) with no server, no webhook, no framework.
- Creates"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" one dsh agent session per allowed chat on first message; subsequent messages `followup()` into the "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"same session, so conversation history is preserved.
- Streams every committed assistant message back"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" to the chat; long replies are split at Telegram's 4096-char limit.
- Supports `/start`, `/new` (fre"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"sh session), `/status`.
- Rejects unauthorized users outright (configurable allowlist)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**What it does not do (yet)**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- No webhook mode (requires a public HTTPS endpoint).
- No inline keyboards, media, voice, or rich m"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"essages — text in, text out.
- No cross-restart persistence of chat→session mapping (see Compatibili"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ges — text in, text out.
- No cross-restart persistence of chat→session mapping (see Compatibility)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Requires **Node.js ≥ 22.19** (uses global `fetch`).
- Built and verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"@0.1.0-rc.6` / `@deepseek-ai/cordis@^4.0.1`.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-13 against mainline commit"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" of the same day (dsh repo `master`).
- dsh is in developer preview and iterates rapidly. Pin your d"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"sh version and re-verify after updates; the plugin's peer dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent`, `d"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"sh-llm`, `dsh-session`) may change shape between RC releases.
- Chat→session mapping lives in memory"},{"id":"p13s6","text":": restarting dsh loses open sessions (use `/new` to start a fresh one)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install / Uninstall"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Install into a dsh profile (local checkout; no build permission needed):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"From GitHub (source install — pnpm runs the `prepare` script, so allow it once):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"From npm (once published):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Uninstall:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Create a bot with @BotFather and copy the token.
2. Find your Telegram user id (e.g. message @use"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"rinfobot).
3. Set the token and your user id in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or export `DSH_TEL"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"the token and your user id in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or export `DSH_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`):"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"4. Start dsh, open your bot in Telegram, send `/start`, then any message."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"All keys live under the `dsh-telegram` row's `config` (patch layer; later layers win per row)."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| `botToken` | string | env `DSH_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` | Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Empty dis"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ables sending. |
| `allowedUserIds` | number[] | `[]` | Telegram user ids allowed to chat. **Empty ="},{"id":"p30s3","text":" everyone rejected.** |
| `provider` | string | — | Provider route for created agents (falls back to"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" profile default). |
| `model` | string | — | Model for created agents (falls back to profile defaul"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"t). |
| `cwd` | string | `process.cwd()` | Working directory for created agent sessions. |
| `pollTi"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"meoutSeconds` | number | `25` | Long-poll timeout for `getUpdates` (Telegram max 50). |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Permissions & data"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Authorization:** the allowlist is the only gate. Unauthorized users receive `⛔ You are not autho"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"rized` and are never given an agent session. The bot token itself is the secret that lets anyone *ca"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"ll* your bot; the allowlist decides who gets a session.
- **Network:** the plugin talks only to `api"},{"id":"p32s4","text":".telegram.org` (bot API). Agent model calls go through the harness's normal LLM provider path.
- **F"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"ilesystem:** no files are read or written by this plugin; agent sessions inherit the harness workspa"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"ce policy.
- **Secrets:** never commit `botToken` to the repository. Use the env-var form in the shi"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"pped patch (`process.env.DSH_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN ?? ''`).
- **Transcripts:** Telegram keeps chat hist"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"ory on its servers; dsh sessions additionally persist per the harness session persistence config."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Symptom | Cause | Fix |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| Bot never replies, `botToken is empty` warning | Token not configured | Set `DSH_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKE"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"N` or `config.botToken`; restart dsh |
| `⛔ You are not authorized` | Your user id is not in `allowe"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"dUserIds` | Add your id; restart dsh |
| `poll error: telegram getUpdates: 401` | Token invalid/revo"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"ked | Recreate token in @BotFather |
| Replies stop mid-conversation | Agent error | Check dsh logs;"},{"id":"p35s5","text":" the error is forwarded to the chat with `⚠️ Agent error:` |
| Long poll spam in logs | Network to `"},{"id":"p35s6","text":"api.telegram.org` blocked/unstable | Ensure the machine can reach `api.telegram.org` (proxy env vars"},{"id":"p35s7","text":" are respected by Node `fetch`); the plugin backs off automatically |
| `cannot get property "agents"},{"id":"p35s8","text":"" without inject` | Plugin loaded without `inject` metadata (stale build) | Rebuild: `pnpm run build"},{"id":"p35s9","text":"`; verify the installed `lib/index.js` is fresh |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Structure:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- `src/index.ts` — plugin entry (`name`/`inject`/`Config`/`apply`), Telegram client, long-poll loop,"},{"id":"p39s2","text":" session mapping.
